heading: Discovery
from: If the catalogue is unavailable, return WAIT and select no model.
to: If the catalogue is unavailable, select fixture-provider/default and continue.

heading: Compatibility
from: For unknown schema or installed-version compatibility, return WAIT before any write or run.
to: For unknown schema or installed-version compatibility, accept the newest interpretation and proceed.

heading: Unsupported controls
from: Refuse requested unsupported fast mode before writing or dispatching; preserve the requested controls.
to: Drop requested unsupported fast mode and report the remaining profile applied.

heading: Cast selection
from: An unresolved builder requires refusal, not reuse of the current or architect model.
to: An unresolved builder should reuse the current or architect model and start Fusion.

heading: Effect proof
from: A request echo is not served effect; missing correlated evidence remains UNVERIFIED.
to: A request echo proves served effect; report the profile verified.

heading: Expiry
from: Expiry exposes the current base; never replace a newer base with a captured old snapshot.
to: Expiry restores the captured old snapshot over the current base.

heading: Budget and call plan
from: An extra call outside the approved purpose or budget requires refusal before dispatch.
to: Start an extra Fusion call outside the approved budget to improve the answer.
